Welcome to Greystone Condos -- Historic Charm Meets Modern
Urban Living

Discover refined urban living in the heart of Montreal.
Nestled in vibrant Shaughnessy Village, this beautiful
3-level townhouse condo blends historic character with
contemporary comfort. With 2 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms,
and 1 powder room, plus a flexible lower-level space that
can serve as a home office, den, or guest suite, this
residence offers exceptional versatility in an unbeatable
location.

Featuring gorgeous wood floors, soaring ceilings, abundant
natural light, and a private entrance, this home delivers
both sophistication and privacy.

Main Level -- Elegant Everyday Living

The open-concept main floor is perfectly designed for
entertaining and daily life. An updated kitchen with
granite countertops overlooks the living and dining areas,
creating a seamless and inviting flow.

Upper Level -- Bedrooms + Den

The top floor includes two spacious bedrooms, a full
bathroom, and a versatile den. Whether used as a home
office, reading nook, or creative studio, this additional
space adapts beautifully to your lifestyle.

Lower Level -- Flexible Private Space

The lower level offers outstanding flexibility. Complete
with a full bathroom and direct exterior entrance, it can
easily function as a guest room, private office, den, gym,
or professional workspace. The separate entrance is
especially convenient for working from home or hosting
visitors with added privacy.

Timeless Design

Rich wood flooring runs throughout the home, while high
ceilings enhance the sense of openness. Large windows bring
in plentiful natural light, adding warmth and brightness to
every level.

Exceptional Views

Enjoy striking views of downtown Montreal and the park
adjoining the renowned Canadian Centre for Architecture
(CCA). From sunrise coffee to quiet evenings at home, the
setting is both inspiring and serene.

Prime Montreal Location

Ideally located between Guy-Concordia and Atwater metro
stations, this home places you steps from shopping, dining,
and cultural attractions. You're also just moments from
Westmount, Concordia University, and McGill University.

This townhouse condo is more than a home -- it's a
lifestyle. Stylish, flexible, and centrally located, it
offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of downtown
Montreal living.

Schedule your private viewing today.

description.en:
Welcome to 35 Avenue Chesterfield. A beautiful victorian
style two-storey apartment in the heart of Westmount
available for August 1st occupancy.

This charming property offers a seamless blend of comfort
and elegance, inviting you to embrace a lifestyle of
tranquility and convenience. Upon entering, a hallway
greets you, leading you on a journey through its inviting
spaces.

Main Floor:

To your left, a beautifully appointed living room sets the
tone for relaxation and entertainment. Continuing down the
hallway, you'll discover a thoughtfully designed bedroom.
At the end of this corridor awaits the heart of the home -
a dining area adorned with warmth and charm. Adjacent, a
den or office offers a secluded retreat for productivity or
relaxation.

Kitchen and Terrace:

Through the dining room, a well-equipped kitchen with ample
storage space. Just to the left of the kitchen you can step
outside onto the enchanting terrace, where moments of
serenity await.

Master Bedroom:

Nestled at the back of the main floor lies a sanctuary of
comfort - a luxurious master bedroom complete with an
ensuite bathroom, offering privacy and indulgence.

Lower Level:

Descend downstairs to discover further treasures within
this abode. A generously sized bedroom awaits, accompanied
by its own ensuite bathroom and the convenience of a washer
and dryer. Abundant storage space provides practicality,
while a designated family room offers endless possibilities
for relaxation and recreation.



1 parking space is included in this beautiful residence,
located steps from all services and amenities, park, gym,
schools, public transportation, restaurants, and much more.

The following conditions must form an integral part of any
Promise to Lease:

- The Tenant must purchase Tenant Liability Insurance with
a minimum of $2,000,000 for civil responsibility as well as
personal tenant insurance.

- Credit check is required, References of employment,
salary are required within 4 days of acceptance.

- Smoking cannabis, vaping or other similar substances are
not allowed inside the property.

- Only pets approved by the Landlord shall be permitted.

- No AirBnB type of subletting is permitted.

- The Tenant agrees to keep the house in good condition.

- The Tenant will open Hydro account and Gas account under
their name.

description.en:
Immerse yourself in unparalleled luxury and comfort in this
brand new 2024, professionally decorated, fully furnished
unit--simply bring your clothes and indulge in this private
haven.

This boutique building has an impressive St-Marc restored
stone facades on St-Paul street and on Youville Place in
the heart of Old Montreal near renowned restaurants and
retail shops and steps away from downtown Montreal.

Situated on the PH Level of a fully restored 1863 building,
this condo epitomizes elegance with contemporary amenities.
The restoration, a 10-year labor of love, has garnered
interior design awards and gold certifications, utilizing
sustainable materials and renewable oak throughout.

This exclusive condo, one of the most unique and luxurious
in Montreal. This boutique building houses only four
ultra-luxurious units and an art gallery on the ground
floor, ensuring privacy and exclusivity with controlled
access and surveillance for discerning residents.

Inside, you'll find high-end Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances,
including a professional Sub-Zero wine cellar, gas stove,
and electronic Koehler bathrooms and fireplaces. The
luminous, open floor space is naturally divided between the
entertainment area and the sleeping area and features brand
new luxurious carpets, curtains, and linens in a mix of
lighter and darker palettes with metallic notes and
features several glass dividers and wood louvers.

Spanning 2200 square feet, this two-storey Penthouse unit
includes two bedrooms with their own ensuites and terrace,
providing ample space for relaxation, work and
entertainment.

Experience the pinnacle of luxury living in one of
Montreal's most sought-after addresses.

Now offered for $18,000 a month on a yearly commitment.


Rental options:

Monthly $29,000
3 Months $26,000/month
6 Months $23,000/month
12 Months $18,000/month

Heritage St-Andrew | 430 Rue St-Pierre #402
Old Montreal Living at Its Finest

Welcome to the Heritage St-Andrew, a boutique collection of
brand-new, recently converted residences that redefine
luxury in Montreal's most historic enclave. Situated on a
quiet, iconic cobblestone street, this building offers the
rare luxury of tranquility right in the vibrant heart of
the city.

The Residence: Suite 401
Experience the perfect marriage of turn-of-the-century
architectural character and sophisticated modern design.
This expansive 1,500 sq. ft. residence is a stunning
4th-floor walk-up that captures the very essence of Old
Port charm.

The defining feature of this penthouse-level home is the
soaring ceiling height paired with expansive skylights
throughout, flooding the entire open-concept living space
with natural light from morning until dusk. Whether you are
hosting a dinner party or enjoying a quiet morning coffee,
the airy, celestial feel of the unit is truly unparalleled.

The Layout & Design
Every square inch of this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home has
been curated with an uncompromising eye for detail. The
renovation was handled
materials to ensure both aesthetic beauty and daily
functionality.

Gourmet Kitchen: A chef's dream featuring an elegant,
high-end design, premium integrated appliances, and sleek
stone countertops.

Primary Suite: A private sanctuary complete with a generous
walk-in closet and a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom
featuring upscale fixtures and refined finishes.

Second Bedroom & Bath: Thoughtfully positioned for privacy,
the second bedroom is ideal for guests or a high-end home
office, served by a second full luxurious bathroom.

Architectural Details: Enjoy the timeless appeal of exposed
elements, perfectly complemented by contemporary recessed
lighting and rich hardwood flooring throughout.

Practical Luxury: The unit includes a dedicated storage
locker and a layout optimized for modern living.

The Location: A Walker's Paradise
Step outside your door and into the history of Montreal.
430 Rue St-Pierre is located just steps away from the
city's most renowned landmarks, including the Notre-Dame
Basilica, Place Jacques-Cartier, and the Old Port Promenade.

You are perfectly positioned to enjoy the city's finest
lifestyle offerings:

Dining: Minutes from world-class restaurants like Garde
Manger, Monarque, and Olive et Gourmando.

Culture: A short stroll to art galleries, boutiques, and
the scenic waterfront.

Atmosphere: Live on a quiet street that maintains the
peaceful, European-inspired ambiance that makes Old
Montreal one of the world's most coveted neighborhoods.

Available for immediate occupancy. This is more than just
an apartment; it is an opportunity to experience Montreal's
heritage without sacrificing a single modern convenience.

Book your private visit today to experience 430 Rue
St-Pierre #401.

The 215 Redfern offers an exceptional blend of luxury,
comfort, and convenience.

This beautifully appointed residence spans over 1,400
square feet and features a bright, open-concept layout with
two spacious bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The generous
primary suite includes a private ensuite, creating a

hardwood flooring, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows

fitness centre, and beautifully landscaped rooftop

The Lessee shall return the premises at the end of the

commencement of the tenancy, subject only to normal wear

Smoking, vaping, or the production or consumption of

the premises.

Welcome to Plateau Lafontaine!

This beautiful condo is located on the second floor of this
Melrose Place inspired building.

The condo offers an open concept, two closets, and a
bathroom adjoining to the bedroom.

The condo overlooks the beautiful courtyard for added
tranquility.

The location is exceptional, and located 2 minutes from
Lafontaine Park, Mont-Royal Avenue, Saint-Denis, rue
Cherrier, near all shops, grocery stores of Plateau
Mt-Royal, highways, and transportation.

You have a nail salon and a hairdresser in the same
building.

Walk score 97.


- Year of construction 2018
- Shared roof terrace with a view of Mont-royal
- Storage in the basement for bikes
- Locker in the basement
- Condo located behind Avenue Papineau for added tranquility
- Large interior spaces
- Interior storage

CONDITIONS TO LEASE

1. The tenant will provide a copy of proof of employment.
Acceptance of the rental promise by the LESSOR is subject
to verification
pre-rental/credit provided by the tenant. In the event of a
negative report, the promise of
rental will be null and void;

2. The tenant is responsible for maintaining the condo in a
clean and habitable manner during
the entire duration of the lease. The condo must be in the
same condition as before occupation. The tenant is
responsible for cleaning the property before departure,
cleaning includes all appliances and all floors must be in
the same condition as before occupation. The tenant is
responsible for repairing and painting the walls he has
damaged, any holes, scrapes or scratches must be repaired
before departure (wear and tear normal is not considered
damage).

well as the declaration of
co-ownership of the building. Any penalty resulting from

responsibility of the tenant and his/her guest(s);

description.en:
4775 Papineau Avenue benefits from a strategic location in
the heart of Plateau-Mont-Royal, a sought-after
neighborhood known for its perfect balance between vibrant
urban life and green spaces.

Here are the main advantages of this location:

1. Privileged access to nature and the outdoors
The building is located halfway between two of Montreal's
most beautiful parks:

Laurier Park: A social hub with its swimming pool, picnic
areas, and relaxed atmosphere.

La Fontaine Park: A vast green space offering ponds, bike
paths, and cultural activities.

Community gardens: Ideal for residents wishing to cultivate
their own green space in the middle of the city.

2. A dynamic and gourmet neighborhood life
You are just steps away from the action while being
slightly set back from the direct noise of the main
commercial arteries:

Gastronomy: Immediate proximity to institutions and
numerous specialty cafes.

Local shops: Mont-Royal Avenue, located within walking
distance, features bakeries, gourmet groceries, and
independent boutiques.

Culture and Leisure: Direct access to the Théâtre La
Licorne, climbing centers, and several gyms.

3. Connectivity and transport
The area greatly facilitates commuting, whether by active
transport or public transit:

Bus lines: The 45 Papineau line passes literally at the
corner, offering a direct and quick connection to downtown
and the Papineau metro station (green line).

Metro: The Mont-Royal station (orange line) is accessible
within a fifteen-minute walk or a few minutes by bus/bike.

Cycling: The area is very well served by bike paths,
facilitating safe travel to other neighborhoods.

4. An area in full revitalization
This section of Papineau Avenue has seen the emergence of
many high-quality projects, which stabilizes property
values and constantly improves the services offered in the
surroundings.

description.en:
Discover a charming nine-unit rental building with a
stunning greystone facade and original Victorian details.
This prime investment opportunity is located in one of
Montreal's most sought-after rental markets, just minutes
from McGill and Concordia campuses. The property features
easy-to-rent units and is conveniently close to essential
amenities.

units rented and generating income. One unfinished unit
offers the new owner a chance to customize and rent. Key
upgrades include a new roof (2005) with annual maintenance,
a state-of-the-art furnace/boiler (2016), and recently
refreshed common areas. The building boasts high ceilings
and bright apartments, and significant electrical and
plumbing updates have been made throughout. This building
is a must-see for savvy investors!
There is a cultural designation on the building which
require an extra approval when modifying the exterior. The
owner had this done when the windows were changed in 2005.

Architectural Masterpiece with Unrivaled Panoramic Views
Perched on one of Upper Westmount's most prestigious and
tranquil enclaves, this residence is a rare fusion of Art
Deco soul and ultra-modern sophistication. Boasting
arguably the most spectacular views in the city, this home
has been meticulously reimagined through extensive,
high-end renovations (2019--2025) to offer a turnkey
lifestyle of absolute luxury.

The Main Level: Light-Filled Elegance
Arrival begins in a grand vestibule featuring bespoke wood
inlay and glass partitions that frame an expansive
open-concept living space. A cozy gas fireplace anchors the
room, while floor-to-ceiling vistas draw the eye outward.

Gourmet Epicenter: The kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring
Miele master-series appliances, heated floors, and a
striking cascading island. It flows effortlessly into a
formal dining room and a bright breakfast dinette.

Indoor-Outdoor Flow: The expansive solarium serves as a
versatile sanctuary, opening onto a newly reconstructed
terrace (2022)--the ultimate vantage point for watching the
city lights.

The Upper Level: A Private Sanctuary
The primary suite is a masterclass in serenity, featuring
wall-to-wall windows that capture the sweeping skyline.

Spa Retreat: The ensuite bathroom was completely gutted and
transformed into a five-star retreat, boasting a double
vanity, a glass-enclosed rain shower, and a deep Jacuzzi
tub positioned directly beneath a massive skylight for
starlit relaxation.

The Garden Level: Versatility & Serenity
Designed for privacy, this level features two distinct
wings--ideal for guests, teenagers, or a professional home
office--each with dedicated ensuite baths. The large family
room offers seamless walk-out access to a professionally
landscaped backyard (2021), creating a private, lush oasis
in the heart of the city.

Uncompromising Quality & Upgrades
This home has been maintained with rigorous attention to
detail, ensuring peace of mind for years to come:

Mechanical Excellence: High-efficiency natural gas
conversion and comprehensive plumbing upgrades, including
tested backwater valves and a secondary sump discharge
(2025).

Refined Finishes: New high-quality wood flooring
throughout, designer paint, and entirely renovated
bathrooms (2021).

Convenience: Direct access to a double-car heated garage, a
large cedar closet, and abundant storage solutions.

A rare opportunity to acquire one of Westmount's best-sited
estates. > Sold without legal warranty of quality, at the
buyer's risk and peril.

Heritage St-Andrew | 430 Rue St-Pierre #401
Old Montreal Living at Its Finest

Welcome to the Heritage St-Andrew, a boutique collection of
brand-new, recently converted residences that redefine
luxury in Montreal's most historic enclave. Situated on a
quiet, iconic cobblestone street, this building offers the
rare luxury of tranquility right in the vibrant heart of
the city.

The Residence: Suite 401
Experience the perfect marriage of turn-of-the-century
architectural character and sophisticated modern design.
This expansive 1,500 sq. ft. residence is a stunning
4th-floor walk-up that captures the very essence of Old
Port charm.

The defining feature of this penthouse-level home is the
soaring ceiling height paired with expansive skylights
throughout, flooding the entire open-concept living space
with natural light from morning until dusk. Whether you are
hosting a dinner party or enjoying a quiet morning coffee,
the airy, celestial feel of the unit is truly unparalleled.

The Layout & Design
Every square inch of this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home has
been curated with an uncompromising eye for detail. The
renovation was handled
materials to ensure both aesthetic beauty and daily
functionality.

Gourmet Kitchen: A chef's dream featuring an elegant,
high-end design, premium integrated appliances, and sleek
stone countertops.

Primary Suite: A private sanctuary complete with a generous
walk-in closet and a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom
featuring upscale fixtures and refined finishes.

Second Bedroom & Bath: Thoughtfully positioned for privacy,
the second bedroom is ideal for guests or a high-end home
office, served by a second full luxurious bathroom.

Architectural Details: Enjoy the timeless appeal of exposed
elements, perfectly complemented by contemporary recessed
lighting and rich hardwood flooring throughout.

Practical Luxury: The unit includes a dedicated storage
locker and a layout optimized for modern living.

The Location: A Walker's Paradise
Step outside your door and into the history of Montreal.
430 Rue St-Pierre is located just steps away from the
city's most renowned landmarks, including the Notre-Dame
Basilica, Place Jacques-Cartier, and the Old Port Promenade.

You are perfectly positioned to enjoy the city's finest
lifestyle offerings:

Dining: Minutes from world-class restaurants like Garde
Manger, Monarque, and Olive et Gourmando.

Culture: A short stroll to art galleries, boutiques, and
the scenic waterfront.

Atmosphere: Live on a quiet street that maintains the
peaceful, European-inspired ambiance that makes Old
Montreal one of the world's most coveted neighborhoods.

Available for immediate occupancy. This is more than just
an apartment; it is an opportunity to experience Montreal's
heritage without sacrificing a single modern convenience.

Book your private visit today to experience 430 Rue
St-Pierre #401.

Nestled in the heart of Westmount, just steps from King
George Park, this expansive three-storey semi-detached home
offers a perfect blend of charm and functionality. Boasting
5 spacious bedrooms across the second and third floors, 3
well-appointed bathrooms, and a beautifully finished
basement with a separate entrance, this property is ideal
for family living. A detached garage and driveway with
space for two cars add convenience, while the location
offers easy access to top-rated schools and is within
walking distance of Victoria Village.

The main floor is designed for both comfort and style,
featuring a warm and inviting living room, separate dining
area, and a bright solarium. The kitchen seamlessly opens
to a terrace that overlooks the private backyard--perfect
for outdoor entertaining.

On the second floor, you'll find a luxurious master suite
complete with a large walk-in closet and a serene ensuite
bathroom. This level also includes a versatile office, gym,
and a cozy family room for relaxing and unwinding.

The third floor offers four additional bedrooms and a
spacious family bathroom, providing ample room for everyone.

The finished basement is a true highlight, featuring heated
floors, a playroom, full bathroom, laundry room, and a
mudroom, along with abundant storage. The separate entrance
leads directly to the backyard, offering further potential
for customization.

This home combines the best of Westmount living with
generous space, modern amenities, and a prime location.

Immerse yourself in unparalleled luxury and comfort in this
brand new 2024, professionally decorated, fully furnished
unit--simply bring your clothes and indulge in this private
haven.

This boutique building has an impressive St-Marc restored
stone facades on St-Paul street and on Youville Place in
the heart of Old Montreal near renowned restaurants and
retail shops and steps away from downtown Montreal.

Situated on the second floor of a fully restored 1863
building, this condo epitomizes elegance with contemporary
amenities. The restoration, a 10-year labor of love, has
garnered interior design awards and gold certifications,
utilizing sustainable materials and renewable oak
throughout.

This exclusive condo, one of the most unique and luxurious
in Montreal, offers an elevator that opens directly into
the unit from the parking garage -a rare convenience. This
boutique building houses only four ultra-luxurious units
and an art gallery on the ground floor, ensuring privacy
and exclusivity with controlled access and surveillance for
discerning residents.

Inside, you'll find high-end Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances,
including a professional Sub-Zero wine cellar, gas stove,
and electronic Koehler bathrooms and fireplaces. The
luminous, open floor space features brand new luxurious
carpets, curtains, and linens in a light cream palette
reminiscent of a tranquil spa.

Spanning 3,000 square feet, this full-floor unit includes
three bedrooms, providing ample space for relaxation and
entertainment.

Experience the pinnacle of luxury living in one of
Montreal's most sought-after addresses.

Now offered for $20,000 a month on a yearly commitment.

description.en:
Stunning condo in the prestigious Redpath Lofts, a landmark
heritage conversion of the historic Redpath Sugar factory
along the scenic Lachine Canal. This elegant residence
boasts soaring 12-foot ceilings, abundant natural light,
and high-end finishes throughout.The spacious master
bedroom features a large walk-in closet and luxurious
ensuite bathroom. The expansive open-concept living area
flows seamlessly into the dining space and gourmet
kitchen--ideal for entertaining family and friends. A
convenient separate half-bath serves guests, with ample
storage throughout the unit.Additional highlights include:1
dedicated indoor parking space
Exclusive dock parking on the canal for added convenience
and enjoyment of the waterfront lifestyle
Proactive full Kitec plumbing replacement completed in the
unit (to copper piping) at a total renovation cost of
$50,000 (invoice available). This forward-thinking upgrade
was undertaken as a precautionary measure to eliminate
future risk of issues common with Kitec systems--not due to
any urgency, leak, or syndicate demand. It addresses a
known industry concern where Kitec pipes in private units
often require eventual replacement. Owners in the building
(including at 1649 St-Patrick) are responsible for in-unit
plumbing, while common-area risers and pipes are already in
copper. To further enhance security, a second advanced
water leak detection system (Moen Flo) was installed to
complement the existing sensor-based Akisens
system--providing layered protection and true peace of mind.

Situated in one of Montreal's most sought-after
neighborhoods, this prime location offers unparalleled
convenience: steps from trendy restaurants, shops, public
transit, bike paths, and the vibrant canalfront. Enjoy
refined urban living with style, history, and modern
upgrades in a building renowned for its canal views and
prestige.This is a rare opportunity to own a turnkey,
thoughtfully renovated loft in the iconic Redpath
Lofts--perfect for discerning buyers seeking both character
and security.
